summary: Implemented the internal durable outbox and scheduling-worker boundary for notifications, SLA, and ads. Strict bounded event contracts reject unknown fields and secret-shaped payloads; Mongo and in-memory repositories provide unique dedupe, optional transaction-session enqueue, atomic worker leases, expiry reclaim, acknowledgement ownership, retry scheduling, and dead-letter persistence. The injected worker dispatches domain handlers, uses deterministic exponential backoff, and fails missing or permanent handlers closed. No HTTP route, production provider, or frontend behavior was invented.
